meta.name: oracle
meta.description: Oracle pattern: math-eval computes a deterministic value, gate asserts it against the expected bound. Fully CLI-castable (no extra caps).

slots.instruction: [WORK SLOT] Replace the math-eval expr and the gate's expected value with your domain oracle rule. For registry-backed oracle verification, swap the gate for an oracle-discharge node (config: {ruleId, expected}) and run under a driver that binds the oracle:read cap (tier 2) — the CLI driver binds only Shell/Fs/Http.
